text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the sun has fallen at Nakayama Racecourse! Who will take home the glory at the end of this year?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide's been doing so awesome lately. I'm definitely going with her!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: No way! It's all about Machitan! She's totally gonna win! Trust me!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? So you're a Tannhauser fan?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yup! I'm not that fast… but that's exactly why I like Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: You like her because… you aren't fast?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I get what you're trying to say. It's like she represents all of us normal people.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That makes her really easy to relate to, and it's encouraging to watch her. I honestly think she's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I think I get it…

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Plus, it's kind of cute how clumsy she is. The other day she got so excited she couldn't even run.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: She almost swallowed a spider that got into her teacup this morning as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness her trainer stopped her…

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Haha, really? She really is so cute—wait! Aren't you Ikuno and Turbo?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gooo, Machitaaan! Gooo, Natuuure!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hayahide! I've heard a lot about you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But! That doesn't matter! I'll be the one taking home the win today!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. They're calling this your comeback race—that you've come back stronger than ever.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However, I'm not planning on giving up this win to anyone. So let's have a clean race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two exchange a firm handshake and start to head off to the turf, when…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: HOLD IT RIGHT THERE!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'M HERE TOO, YOU KNOW!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah. You're pretty much yelling.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I've decided something today. Today… I'm walking straight down the center. I'm gonna win…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And I'm gonna be the star of the show!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser has always made sure to stay out of the way of the other Umamusume in the runners' tunnel. According to her…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You know how rivals shake hands at the climax of a movie?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's not a moment for an ordinary gal like me to barge in on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, she's declaring that she's going to make herself known. In other words, that shows exactly how much—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I mean it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I got it! You know, I've heard a lot about you too. Don't think I don't have my eye on you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I came here to win today. I'm not letting anyone else be the star of the show. So… bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I will!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I feel the same. I've already looked into all of your data.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If the winner of today's race is the "star," then I have no intention of letting anyone else have the title.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You're on!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That goes for you over there too, Nature! I'm not losing to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What?! I mean, uhhh, me too! I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The four of them exchange glances and exit the runners' tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Until Matikanetannhauser comes back for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I forgot something! There's something I want to do!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Um, will you do a cheer with me? Since today's a special day and all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Heehee. Okay, here we go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Go, go, Arima Kinen! Ei, ei…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right! Here I go!
